scenarios.scenario: Concurrent readers, cached reads, hung worker and autonomous task deadline
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: One fixed collector task; no retained hung Activity worker; WinRM process count returned to baseline.

scenarios.scenario: Six real WinRM readers; two independent remote recovery shells; cross-console ownership fixture
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Temporary Busy does not latch; recovered snapshot is shared, second repair does not change task LastRunTime; ownership guards pass.

scenarios.scenario: Abruptly terminate owned test agent in four simulated phases; reconcile boot/ownership/result
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Four unknown interrupted outcomes reconciled; live/busy/grace safeguards, backups and one fresh UpdateScan verified. No real CBS installation or physical power loss was tested.

scenarios.scenario: Real SYSTEM hung supervisor removal, foreign configuration, disabled marker, explicit reinstall
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Owned collector removed; foreign objects/Maintenance preserved; repeated deletion idempotent; fresh complete result required; concurrent repair shared.

scenarios.scenario: Controlled delayed success/failure and endpoint change; old/new polling generation; actual WinRM lifecycle
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Obsolete replies ignored, current positive controls accepted. Physical VPN disruption was not performed; transport failures/reconnect state transitions were injected.

scenarios.scenario: Saved OFF on cold startup and restart; queued reads, OFF/ON; collector inspection/history
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Zero startup transport entries; old generation remains cancelled; explicit read actions respect OFF; installs are not terminated.

scenarios.scenario: Same-boot positive reboot, fresh negative, new boot partial, prior WSUS failure, saved readiness
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Status/criteria assertions pass; age alone does not erase confirmed readiness; stale/partial data does not create success.

scenarios.scenario: Actual WPF rendering in three themes, compact/wide windows, commands/WSUS/history/settings
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Generated Windows screenshots inspected; common header and poll/auto placement retained; visual tests pass.

scenarios.scenario: Background completion with A/B/C selections; UI load of 450 computers and 10000 events
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Selection/tab/editor/copy/scroll assertions pass; input dispatcher serviced; no repeated history disk reads or unchanged-row notification storm.

scenarios.scenario: Forty output steps, intermediate stderr, repeated lines, 1 MiB notice, reopen/copy
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Numeric step order and earlier output preserved; structured stderr and truncation notice visible; actual PowerShell/CMD execution checks pass.

scenarios.scenario: Isolated cache/service adapters and abrupt PowerShell child termination
scenarios.expected: Pass the specified bounded regression without touching production clients or services.
scenarios.actual: Original failure and restoration evidence retained; busy installer and partial restoration prevent false success. Production services and caches were not changed.
